title: Coordinate Transformation Conversion
text: 转换为指定的坐标变换表示，输入 2 路；按 {Axis rotation sequence} 指定欧拉角轴旋转顺序；{Representation} 指定输入表示 Axis-Angle、{Show TrVec input port} 指定切换 TrVec 端口、{Show TrVec output port} 指定切换 TrVec 端口、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input transformation
ports.summary: 坐标变换 column vector | 3-by-3 matrix | 4-by-4 matrix

ports.name: Output transformation
ports.summary: 坐标变换 column vector | 3-by-3 matrix | 4-by-4 matrix

ports.name: TrVec
ports.summary: 平移向量 three-element column vector

params.name: Representation
params.values: 输入表示 Axis-Angle | Euler Angles | Homogeneous Transformation | Quaternion | Rotation Matrix | Translation Vector

params.name: Axis rotation sequence
params.values: 欧拉角轴旋转顺序 ZYX (default) | ZYZ | XYZ

params.name: Show TrVec input port
params.values: 切换 TrVec 端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Show TrVec output port
params.values: 切换 TrVec 端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
